emails.subject: Welcome to your workspace!
emails.preview: Hi! Everything is set up and ready to go. Here is what you need to know.
emails.body:
Hi!

Your workspace is all set up and ready to go. Here is a quick overview of what is available to you:

  • Mail — send and receive messages
  • Files — manage your documents
  • Calendar — schedule meetings

Let me know if you need any help getting started.

Welcome aboard,
Jackson

emails.subject: Re: Project proposal
emails.preview: Thanks for sending the proposal over. I have reviewed it and have a few thoughts.
emails.body:
Hi John,

Thanks for sending the proposal over. I have reviewed it and have a few thoughts to share.

Overall the scope looks good, but I think we should revisit the timeline for phase two. Can we schedule a call this week?

Best,
Me

emails.preview: Great speaking with you today. Here are the next steps we discussed.

Hi,

Great speaking with you today. As discussed, here are the next steps:

Looking forward to working together.
